test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

SLY
solution:
The correct answer is **'Honest**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Sly**' is '**Honest**'.
 
• **Sly**: (used about a person) acting or done in a secret or dishonest way, often intending to trick people. ((व्‍यक्ति या कार्य) चोरी-छिपे या बेईमानी से काम करने वाला या किया गया, प्रायः लोगों को धोखा देने की मंशा से; कपटपूर्ण, बेईमानी भरा; धूर्त)
 
 
• *Example: She was **sly**, selfish, and manipulative.*
 
 
 
• **Honest**: (used about a person) telling the truth; not lying to people or stealing. (ईमानदार)
 
 
• *Example: Just be **honest**—do you like this skirt or not?*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Honest.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Stiff**: (used about material, paper, etc.) firm and difficult to bend or move. ((वस्‍तु, काग़ज़ आदि) सख्‍़त, कड़ा और न झुकने या मुड़ने वाला)
 
• **Thick**: (used about something solid) having a large distance between its opposite sides; not thin. ((ठोस वस्‍तु) मोटी या मोटा; पतला या बारीक से विपरीत)
 
• **Slow**: moving, doing something or happening without much speed; not fast. (धीमी गति से चलते, करते या घटित होते हुए, धीमा या धीमे; वेग से नहीं, मंद)
